subject_name: Aircraft Electrical equipment, Power generation and Distribution
specific_objectives: 15.1.8.2 Trainee will be able to explain Desynn type pressure indicating system.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of Desynn indicator mechanism operation; Safety: Ensure no loose tools near rotating parts; Supervision: Instructor monitors alignment and torque application.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a Desynn system?
How does a pressure indicating system differ from a torque meter?
Name one application of Desynn systems in aircraft instrumentation.

development.content:
Desynn system basic principle
Encoder and decoder components
Pressure to electrical conversion
Signal transmission path
Indicator display mechanism

Desynn indicator construction
Rotor and stator interaction
Pressure sensing element function
System calibration procedures
Common failure modes

System integration in cockpit
Maintenance and inspection
Troubleshooting steps
Replacement procedures
Safety checks during maintenance

summary_questions: Explain how pressure is converted into a readable value in a Desynn system.
Describe the role of the encoder and decoder in the Desynn circuit.
List three safety precautions when handling Desynn indicator components.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the operational differences between the Desynn pressure system and the torque meter system covered in LP 21.
